## History

Throughout his life, Thomas Lynde was ruled by his mother until he married [Rachel](../character/rachel-lynde.md), who then continued to dominate him. His death left [Rachel](../character/rachel-lynde.md) in need of new living arrangements, leading [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) to invite her to move into [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) so she could remain in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea).

_Sources: [v2 XXII Odds and Ends P13](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0013), [v2 XXVI Around the Bend P0](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0000), [v2 XXVI Around the Bend P15](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0015), [v2 XXVI Around the Bend P26](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0026), [v2 XXVI Around the Bend P35](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0035)_

## Relationships

### [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/rachel-lynde--thomas-lynde.md)

Thomas Lynde was the husband of [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) until his death. His passing leaves [Rachel](../character/rachel-lynde.md) unable to remain in her home, prompting [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) to invite her to move into [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) so she can stay in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea).
